blocks.text: Body Modifications: Elaborate grille guards, protruding visors, oversized bumper extensions, and customized mirror brackets.
Metalwork: Heavy use of golden chassis parts, polished chrome, and gleaming stainless steel.
Neon Lighting: LED arrays, colored lightbulbs, hundreds of neon tubes, and ultraviolet lights that illuminate the vehicle like a maximalist spaceship.
Decorative Fixtures: Custom lamps, Mini-chandeliers, hanging ornaments, and high-end brand accessories.
Luxurious Upholstery: Bright, velvet, lavish fabrics, and brocade concealing the seats and dashboards.
Art and Murals: Airbrushed murals or detailed hand-painted depictions of traditional mythical creatures, Japanese landscapes, gods, or pop-culture icons.
